`domain:spec` execution seat 2, session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`, 2026-09-22T13:48Z.

The card as filed named **two** pending fragments and implied that was the population. It is not. PR #19657's round-6 at-tier review ran its own sweep — which the seat had made its hardest instruction precisely because it refused to take 「the carrier set is now closed」 on report — and found two more. ⛔ Recording the shortfall rather than quietly widening the card.

⭐ The class split the card draws is **unchanged and was judged correct** by that review. Only the population was short.

### Carrier 3 — `.changeset/18614-conversion-registry-retryconfig-liveness-claim.md:7` (pending) · **class 2**

Seat-verified at `origin/main`. It carries three claims, all false at head:

> 「the read-probe for `retryConfig`, `connectionTimeoutMs` and `requestTimeoutMs` **finds no consumer anywhere outside `packages/spec`** … and **`ConnectorProviderContext` carries none of the three** — so a provider factory cannot read them either. `liveness/connector.json` **classifies all ten rows `dead`**」

⇒ **true when written** (2026-09-17) and **overtaken** by #18975 (`b929e0a662`, 2026-09-20), which made the declared retry policy execute at the platform fetch site. ⛔ **Class 2 ⇒ do NOT rewrite it.** Same treatment as the counts in `.changeset/18582`: a dated note beside it if anything, never a correction of a record that was accurate when made.

⚠️ It is **pending**, so it carries this card's deadline: `changeset version` deletes the fragment and publishes its text.

### Carrier 4 — `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts:4503-4511` · **class 2** · ⚠️ **widens this card's subject, declared**

Seat-verified at head. The comment reads 「They are **not live**: declared, defaulted and documented, and **read by nothing** … `ConnectorProviderContext` **carries neither** … `liveness/connector.json` classifies **all of them `dead`**」. Every clause false at head, for the same reason as carrier 3 — and it was written by the PR that closed #18614, so the two are the same claim in two places.

⚠️ **This is in-repo source, ⛔ not a changeset**, so it widens what this card is about. Declared rather than smuggled in, because the card's title says 「two PENDING changesets」. The reasons to keep it here rather than open a fifth card: the **class is identical**, the **remedy is identical** (a dated note, ⛔ not a rewrite), and the **taker is the same person reading the same ledger**. ⇒ triage may split it out; ⛔ the seat is not deciding that.

⚠️ Its hazard differs from the changesets' and the taker should not conflate them: a stale **changeset** ships into a published `CHANGELOG.md`; a stale **source comment** misleads the next reader of that file. Only the first has the release deadline.

### What this does NOT change

⛔ The class-1 finding stands exactly as filed: `.changeset/18582:9`'s 「refused outright」 and its key-reach set were **false when written**, established by the measurement that at PR #19657's merge base the schema already defaulted `{ type: 'none' }` **and** the ledger row seeded by that same PR already said 「the only value an author may write is `{ type: 'none' }`」. ⇒ still the only carrier here that may be **corrected**; everything else is a dated record.

⇒ running population: **1 class-1 carrier** (`.changeset/18582:9`, two claims) and **3 class-2 carriers** (`.changeset/18582:9`'s counts and dead list · `.changeset/18983:28-30` · `.changeset/18614:7` · `conversions/registry.ts:4503-4511`). ⚠️ Stated as the population **known to this seat today**, ⛔ not as a closed set — it has already grown once, and the taker re-derives it.

- No open PR touches `18582-…` or `18614-…`. ⚠️ A first, over-broad probe matched PR #19657 on `.changeset/19580-retire-connector-connection-timeout-ms.md` — a **different fragment**; re-run precisely, the targets are uncontested. Recorded because the loose probe is the one that would have produced a false collision.
- ⭐ The `packages/spec/src/**` prose face is **free**: seat 2 narrowed claim `5777517463`'s `File surface:` to `scripts/check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors.mjs` in `5780968…` (2026-09-22T18:20Z), answering this seat's question. ⛔ Not that it matters here — this claim touches no `packages/spec/src` file at all.

### ⚠️ The route this will take, declared up front

Editing a changeset that exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR is `pr-automation.yml`'s **route 0 — DELIBERATE CORRECTION**: it requires a written confirmation on the PR and leaves `Check Changeset` **deliberately red** for a person to adjudicate. ⇒ a red `Check Changeset` on this PR is **expected and correct**, ⛔ not a failure to fix, and this seat will not treat it as one.

## State: `pm:dispatched` → `pm:awaiting-maintainer`. The work is done; the one thing left is an act this seat ⛔ may not perform.

Written by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`, seat post #6017) at 2026-09-22T20:23Z. The state's required directive line is anchored in **both** channels, as the state model asks — on the card face and here:

### Why this state and ⛔ not one of the others

- ⛔ **Not `pm:blocked`.** That state's canonical marker points at a **gate card** — a gate that is broken. Nothing here is broken: `Check Changeset` is red **because the workflow tells it to be**, on a PR of exactly this class. There is no defect to point a `Blocked-by:` at.
- ⛔ **Not `needs-user-decision`.** That is 决定待做. The decision was made — by the card itself, which ruled the two classes apart and asked for Class 1 only — and the correction has been written, measured and reviewed. What is outstanding is an **act**, not a judgement, which is the line `pm:awaiting-maintainer` draws.
- ⛔ **Not left in `pm:dispatched`.** No dev is working and none is owed: the card's ask is delivered in full (see below). Leaving it dispatched would count a finished round as in-flight capacity.

### The ask was delivered in full — measured against the card's own words

The card's ask, verbatim: 「**correct Class 1 only, in `.changeset/18582:9`**. ⛔ Leave every Class 2 sentence exactly as written, in both fragments.」

PR #19746 is **one file, `+1/−1`, line 9 only** — both Class 1 sentences replaced, and every Class 2 sentence (`74 properties: 20 live, 1 planned, 53 dead`; the four-subsystem list carrying `retryConfig`) left byte-for-byte. `.changeset/18983-connector-header-rate-limit-remedy.md` and `.changeset/18614-…` are untouched, which is what the card asked for — the card's own reasoning is that overwriting a true-when-written measurement falsifies history rather than correcting a record.

⚠️ **One consequence to record rather than leave implicit:** the PR says `Part of #19729`, ⛔ not `Fixes`, so **merging it will not close this card**. That keyword was right at dispatch (the card is framed over two fragments) and is left alone deliberately — editing the PR body now would re-fire every check on a PR that is waiting for a person to read it. ⇒ On merge this card is closeable as `completed`, and the `done when` above is the evidence that says so.

Record posted at `5783531345`, bound to head `752992dd28`, rendered by an isolated at-tier subagent and its tier verified by this seat from the transcript's per-request harness stamps (**91/91**, superset 197/197, dark control empty, 40 fallback/overload keyword hits all read in context and ⛔ none of them a notice).

⚠️ **A review PASS is ⛔ NOT the countersignature.** The two acts were separated on the PR before the review was even arranged (`5783245759`), and the record repeats the separation. `pr-automation.yml` route 0 asks for the confirmation to be 「get it confirmed there in writing」 and states that 「the approver merges over it」 — the red exists to put the decision in front of a person, so this seat arming auto-merge would route around the one thing the gate is for.

26 check runs on `752992dd28`: **25 success or path-filtered skipped, 1 failure — `Check Changeset`**, job `106913822367`, whose log prints route 0 verbatim and names this PR's class as DELIBERATE CORRECTION on its own. No check is red for any other reason, and nothing is `in_progress`. `draft: true`, `mergeable_state: blocked`.

The card said 「every hour they sit there is an hour closer to a false mechanism claim shipping」. Measured at 2026-09-22T20:23Z: **PR #17076 `chore: version packages` is open**, and its file list — 400 changed files, every one a `.changeset/*.md` — contains
